title: Affine basis section comparison for the symmetric algebra
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $F$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], and $W$ an affine open. Put $R=\mathcal O_X(W)$, $A=\operatorname{Sym}_R(F(W))$, and $i:\operatorname{Spec}R\to X$ for its affine chart [lem-weil-pbc-affine-open-spec-points]. Let $P$ be the presheaf of sectionwise symmetric algebras [lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-algebra-sheaf-construction], $T=\widetilde A$ [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections], $\theta$ the ring sheafification unit, and $\alpha:T\to i^*(P^\#)$ the comparison [def-weil-pbc-symmetric-algebra-affine-comparison-map]. On the full category of affine opens of $\operatorname{Spec}R$, there is a natural transformation of underlying abelian presheaves $\gamma:i^*P\to T$ with every component bijective and $\alpha_V\gamma_V=\theta_{i(V)}$ on each affine open $V$. This statement is about sections and their restrictions on the affine basis only; no assertion about stalks or sheafification bijectivity is assumed.

source.place: Lemma 01I8, together with Modules Lemma 01CH and Algebra Lemma 0C6F

proof.text: For each affine V in Spec R, use IsAffineOpen.image_of_isOpenImmersion to see that U=i(V) is affine, and fromSpec_image_le to see U lies in W. Apply quasiCoherent_affine_section_baseChange to F on U≤W and swap tensor factors. Its bijectivity and O(U)-linearity produce the O(U)-linear equivalence O(U) tensor_R F(W) ≃ F(U), sending r tensor m to r times restriction(m).

source.place: Lemma 01LN, applying affine quasi-coherent section base change

proof.text: Extend the module equivalence by symmetric-algebra lifts in both directions (the private symmetricCongr construction). Compose it with baseChange_bijective to obtain the O(U)-linear equivalence ell: O(U) tensor_R A ≃ Sym_O(U)(F(U)). Symmetric algebra induction proves ell(r tensor a)=r times restriction(a). For T=tilde(A), apply quasiCoherent_affine_section_baseChange on V≤top. Use isoTop and equivOfCompatibleSMul to replace the tensor base Γ(Spec R,top) by R; the latter replacement is valid because ΓSpecIso is an isomorphism. This gives beta: O(V) tensor_R A ≃ T(V), with beta(r tensor a)=r times toOpen(A,V)(a). The chart appIso is R-linear by ΓSpecIso_inv_map_appIso_inv. Tensor it with the identity of A and set g_V=beta composed with this tensor equivalence and ell inverse. Its pure tensor formula is the required scalar/restriction formula.

Surjectivity of ell and additive tensor induction show that every sectionwise symmetric-algebra section on U is generated additively by r times restriction(a), with a in A. Choose the proved equivalences g_V and use their additive homomorphisms as the components of gamma. Naturality is proved by this section induction: zero and addition follow from additivity, while a scalar/restriction generator follows from restriction_smul, restriction composition, the g_V formula, tilde.toOpen_res and appIso_hom_naturality. Each component is bijective because g_V is an additive equivalence. The unit factorization is proved by the same section induction. On a generator use the g_V formula, linearity of affineComparison and sectionLinearMap, affineComparison_toOpen, the explicit inverse of sectionsTopRestrictFromSpecEquiv, and naturality of toSheafify. The two section restrictions compose to W→i(V), giving exactly the sectionMap formula. This proves the complete unchanged statement, with no new sorry.

theorem exists_affineSectionComparison {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] {W : X.Opens} (hW : IsAffineOpen W) :
    let B : (Spec Γ(X, W)).affineOpens → (Spec Γ(X, W)).Opens := Subtype.val
    ∃ γ : (inducedFunctor B).op ⋙ hW.fromSpec.opensFunctor.op ⋙ presheaf F ⋙
        (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat ⋙ forget₂ RingCat AddCommGrpCat.{u}) ⟶
      (inducedFunctor B).op ⋙
        (Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf (Spec Γ(X, W))).obj
          (tilde (R := Γ(X, W)) (ModuleCat.of Γ(X, W) (sections F (op W)))),
      (∀ V : (Spec Γ(X, W)).affineOpens, Function.Bijective (γ.app (op V))) ∧
      (∀ V : (Spec Γ(X, W)).affineOpens,
        γ.app (op V) ≫
          ((Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf (Spec Γ(X, W))).map
            (affineComparison F hW)).app (op V.1) =
          (whiskerLeft hW.fromSpec.opensFunctor.op
            (whiskerRight (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (presheaf F))
              (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat ⋙ forget₂ RingCat AddCommGrpCat.{u}))).app
            (op V.1))
